_comment: MODEL L (Assamese) reasoning finetune. Consumed by common/finetune.py via FinetuneConfig.from_json. Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation.
_init: Starts from Model L's own Phase 2 best.pt (step 9,110, validation
loss 3.9043). finetune.py refuses a checkpoint whose model_config
names a different language. The path is the local staging directory
from common/workspace.py; pass --init to point elsewhere.
_schedule: Every value except the language and checkpoint is identical to
telugu/configs/finetune_h.json, so that a Model H versus Model L
difference is attributable to the pretrained models and not to two
finetuning recipes. See that file for the reasoning behind each value.
name: model_l_reasoning
